items.summary: Kimi Antonelli 初めてのレースでフォーミュラ1 世界選手権を封印できませんでしたが、イタリアは、この週末の歴史を作るための素晴らしい機会を残しました Mexico City.
items.title_original: How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday
items.summary_original: Kimi Antonelli was unable to seal the Formula 1 world championship at the first race where it was mathematically possible for him to do so, but the Italian has left himself with a great opportunity to make history this weekend in Mexico City.
